data_type: Synthetic outcome IDs; no LLM calls
estimator: Global singleton count attributed to an arm divided by that arm's total pulls, including unsuccessful pulls. A second observation from any arm removes the singleton.
initialization: All UCB methods pull each arm once in a randomized order. Uniform is iid; round robin cycles a randomized order. Oracle chooses maximal true remaining probability mass from the outset.
outcomes: Each pull fails to discover an outcome with probability 1-q. On success, choose shared pool with probability overlap, otherwise the selected arm's private pool; draw uniformly inside that pool. Private pools are disjoint and disjoint from shared pool.
pairing: All methods see the same pre-generated iid per-arm streams, indexed by that arm's pull count. Arm profiles are permuted per canonical replicate or generated environment. Outcome streams and policy randomization are separate. No ordinary selector receives distribution parameters.
generated_environment_sampling: Draw each pool size independently and uniformly over its integer range and q uniformly over its interval, once per environment. Evaluate all generated environments; no rejection or performance-based selection.
statistics: 95% paired percentile bootstrap CIs, 5000 resamples. Canonical resampling unit is a replicate. Generated resampling unit is an environment after averaging its eight replicates. Paired two-sided t-test, Holm adjustment across the eight Good-UCB(0.5)-versus-uniform comparisons at budget 150. Other coefficients, methods, budgets, allocation, and cumulative coverage are descriptive secondary analyses.
controls: overlap=1 gives identical distributions for all arms and is the negative control. overlap=0 is the diversity positive control. Oracle is an informed greedy comparator, not claimed to be a general upper bound under overlap.
stopping: Run every frozen condition to horizon 300. No coefficient selection, early stopping, or design changes in response to observed performance. Source and protocol hashes recorded before execution. Implementation corrections require explicit documentation.
scope: Mechanism demonstration and robustness within a constructed family, not evidence of LLM attack performance, semantic vulnerability coverage, or general superiority. Existing v1/v2 null results remain valid.
